articles.title: Frist Derivative invests £15.5 million to build AI centre of excellence in Ireland
articles.summary: First Minister Michelle O’Neill, Deputy First Minister Emma Little-Pengelly and Economy Minister Dr Caoimhe Archibald have today announced a £15.3 million investment by First Derivative in research, development and job creation at a new AI and Fintech Centre of Excellence.

articles.title: Arva AI opens Research Lab to banish human-in-the-loop for financial crime and fraud
articles.summary: Arva AI, backed by Y Combinator and Google's AI Fund, announced the launch of its Research Lab, a research division building the proprietary models and infrastructure that let banks automate highest-risk decisions, already used by global financial institutions including a top-10 US bank.
